$comment: Immutable v2 URI. The authored file name is scenario.schema.json; the versioned $id is the contract identity and MUST NOT be reused for a breaking change. A promoted copy under schemas/scenarios/v2/ keeps this $id byte-for-byte, or a new vN file with a new $id is issued. Migration: v1 was a pre-release draft with condition-only thresholds; v2 is the first published immutable version and introduces structured predicates, required environment.apiVersion, required summary/determinism/scenarioKind, and typed initialization commands. v1 is not supported by the v2 runner.
title: Living Roots Verification Scenario
description: Canonical machine-readable scenario definition for the headless game verification runner (spec 010). JSON is the canonical format; an optional Markdown companion checklist may accompany it for contributor readability. Draft 2020-12, strict objects, immutable versioned $id. v2 introduces structured predicate thresholds, environment metadata, host-guard fields, typed initialization commands, explicit determinism metadata, and an explicit absence-vs-null policy: null is never a valid value for any field; an omitted optional field takes its declared default, and an omitted required field is invalid.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Payload version. v2 is the first published schema version and is immutable. Any breaking change requires a new vN file and a new $id; a deprecated alias may be retained for at most one minor version.

scenarioId.title: Scenario identifier
scenarioId.description: Unique kebab-case slug for this scenario. Used as the stable test-case identifier in reports and quarantine entries.

featureSlug.title: Feature slug
featureSlug.description: Spec feature slug this scenario verifies (NNN-slug). Must match the target feature folder under specs/.

testMdPath.title: Path to test.md
testMdPath.description: Relative path to the feature's Gate 3 test.md. Must exist and contain exactly one GATE3 marker block; validated fail-fast before launch (FR-008/FR-016). Absolute paths, '..' segments, and backslashes are rejected by the pattern.

summary.title: Human-readable summary
summary.description: Required plain-language description of what the scenario proves. Advisory only; the thresholds remain the machine oracle.
examples: Poor soil slows crop growth by 15% relative to vanilla.

playerRole.title: Expected player role
playerRole.description: Expected player role for host-guard evaluation (FR-011). A farmhand scenario MUST also declare hostGuard.

minimumGameVersion.title: Minimum game version
minimumGameVersion.description: Per-scenario game version floor. Must be greater than or equal to the mod manifest's MinimumGameVersion. The runner compares this against the file-based version gate before launch.

environment.title: Declared environment
environment.description: Expected execution environment. The runner records the observed values in the evidence bundle and fails fast on a mismatch (FR-008). Declared values make the scenario reproducible without relying on host-global state.

saveId.title: Save ID
saveId.description: Expected in-game save identifier after load, used to locate sidecars (soil_health_data_{saveId}.json, composting_bins_{saveId}.json). Must match the milestone manifest saveId for the selected milestoneSave; a mismatch is a scenario-contract error (exit 14).

config.title: Runner configuration
config.description: Expected runner configuration for this scenario. The object MUST be present; omitted members take their declared defaults.

saveMode.title: Save mode
saveMode.description: Whether the game may write saves during the scenario. Clean-quit scenarios MUST use save.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Whether the game runs under Xvfb without a visible window.

skipBuild.title: Skip build
skipBuild.description: Whether the runner reuses an already-built mod instead of rebuilding it.

apiVersion.title: Mod API version
apiVersion.description: Version of the production mod API contract (ILivingRootsModApi.ApiVersion) this scenario requires. Distinct from modVersion; a mismatch is a HARD-FAIL version-gate classification.

milestoneSave.title: Milestone save name
milestoneSave.description: Source milestone save folder name in the private builddeps repository. Must match the milestone manifest saveName. This is the read-only seed folder; environment.saveId is the expected in-game save ID after load. They may differ in spelling but both must match the same milestone manifest entry.

background.title: Shared preconditions
background.description: Optional shared setup commands executed before initCommands. Equivalent to a Background/common block; scenario-specific initCommands and steps follow. The runner executes background first, then initCommands.

initCommands.title: Initialization commands
initCommands.description: Ordered initialization commands. Macro commands reference plain-text macro files (one '/' command per line); console commands invoke registered SMAPI mod commands. The runner executes them after background and before the first step. An empty array is valid for a scenario that needs no setup.

steps.title: Scenario steps
steps.description: Ordered step list; array order is the single source of truth (no dependsOn field). Prefer 3-5 steps; decompose longer scenarios into multiple scenarios.

thresholds.title: Thresholds (acceptance oracle)
thresholds.description: Machine-evaluable acceptance criteria. Each threshold is a structured predicate; prose descriptions are advisory only.

expectedSignals.title: Expected signals
expectedSignals.description: All three mandatory signals must be captured for host runs (SC-002). Exactly three unique values are required. Farmhand host-guard runs additionally assert the absence of Crop-phase mutation, as declared by hostGuard.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Per-scenario timeout in seconds. Optional; when omitted, the runner uses 300 seconds. A macro timeout is a retryable transient class (FR-011).

inputs.title: Scenario-level inputs
inputs.description: Explicit scenario-level inputs. No hidden global state, clock, or RNG seed is allowed (C-SCN-20). Omitted members take their declared defaults.

season.title: Season
season.description: Starting season for the seeded save.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Starting weather. Festival days are excluded from growth evaluation unless the scenario explicitly opts in.

money.title: Money
money.description: Starting money. Capitalized to avoid the game's chat-secret token.

rngSeed.title: RNG seed
rngSeed.description: Declared RNG seed for reproducibility (C-SCN-20). Required so a run can be replayed deterministically.

time.title: Declared time
time.description: Declared UTC time context in ISO 8601 compact form (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) for reproducibility (C-SCN-20).

determinism.title: Determinism declaration
determinism.description: Explicit statement that re-running the scenario from the same seed/environment yields the same result. Required. Any non-deterministic source must be declared; an undeclared source is a scenario-contract violation.

idempotent.title: Idempotent
idempotent.description: Re-running from the same seed/environment MUST yield the same verdict. A scenario that cannot meet this is invalid.

declaredSources.title: Declared non-deterministic sources
declaredSources.description: Known sources of non-determinism that the runner must control or record. An empty array asserts full determinism.

criticalPath.title: Critical-path scenario
criticalPath.description: Marks a scenario that is never quarantinable (C-REL-23), for example save/load round-trip or core crop-growth threshold evaluation.

scenarioKind.title: Scenario kind
scenarioKind.description: Required intent declaration. Positive scenarios declare pass; negative scenarios declare a non-pass expectedVerdict; boundary scenarios declare pass or fail.

expectedVerdict.title: Expected verdict
expectedVerdict.description: Expected base run verdict. The runner asserts actual == expected for negative/boundary scenarios and treats a mismatch as a scenario-contract failure (exit 19). 'flaky' is a derived metadata flag, not an expected base verdict. A matched expectedVerdict=fail still exits 18 (the gameplay assertion failed as designed); use --ignore-exit-code 18 only in an explicitly expected-failure lane.

hostGuard.title: Host-guard expectations
hostGuard.description: Required when playerRole is farmhand. Declares the observable skip line and the forbidden execution evidence used to detect a host-guard breach (FR-011).

semver.title: Semantic version
semver.description: Version in numeric semver form. Non-standard channels such as -unofficial.* are accepted but classified by the version gate.

oneOf.title: NaN sentinel
oneOf.description: RFC 8259 has no NaN literal; the string "NaN" is the only permitted representation (C-SCN-26). Use the named sentinel enum where missing-key or other named semantics are required.

numericValue.title: Numeric value
numericValue.description: A number or the string "NaN". Use the sentinel enum where a named sentinel is required.

oneOf.title: Measured soil health
oneOf.description: A measured health value in the 0-100 range. Zero is a measured floor, not an absence.

oneOf.title: Unmeasured soil health
oneOf.description: The string "NaN" means unmeasured (missing key or stored NaN), never 0% health.

soilHealthValue.title: Soil health value
soilHealthValue.description: A measured 0-100 value or the "NaN" unmeasured sentinel.

numericField.title: Numeric signal field
numericField.description: A signal field with numeric semantics.

booleanField.title: Boolean signal field
booleanField.description: A signal field with boolean semantics.

stringField.title: String signal field
stringField.description: A signal field with string semantics.

field.title: Signal field
field.description: Closed vocabulary of fields that thresholds may evaluate. Numeric fields accept numbers; boolean fields accept booleans; string fields accept strings. New fields require a schema version bump.

sentinel.title: Sentinel
sentinel.description: Named sentinel constant (C-SCN-03/C-SCN-27). SENTINEL_UNTOUCHED_99999 = the phaseDays sentinel; NAN_HEALTH = a stored NaN health value (unmeasured, not 0); MISSING_KEY = no SoilHealthState entry (non-participant); HEALTH_LE_ZERO = measured floor at or below zero (non-participant); POOR_POSITIVE_LT_34 = strictly positive health below 34; PHASE_MINUS_ONE = currentPhase < 0, excluded from evaluation.

oneOf.title: Macro initialization command
oneOf.description: Runs a plain-text macro file via 'debug runmacro <file>'. The file is UTF-8 (BOM tolerated), LF or CRLF, one '/' command per line; blank lines are skipped and non-'/' lines are rejected. The file name MUST include its .txt extension.

file.title: Macro file
file.description: Relative path to a .txt macro file. Absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected.

description.title: Description
examples: place the composting bin on the target tile

oneOf.title: Console initialization command
oneOf.description: Invokes a registered SMAPI mod console command. Debug commands (which belong in macros) are rejected: the command MUST NOT start with 'debug '.

command.title: Console command
command.description: Single-line registered SMAPI command, without a leading 'debug ' prefix and without newlines.

description.title: Description
examples: seed poor soil on the target tile

stepInputs.title: Step inputs
stepInputs.description: Explicit action-specific inputs. Unknown fields are rejected; omitted fields are absent (no implicit global state).

tileX.title: Tile X
tileX.description: Tile X coordinate, bounded to the mod's MaxAbsoluteTileCoordinate.

tileY.title: Tile Y
tileY.description: Tile Y coordinate, bounded to the mod's MaxAbsoluteTileCoordinate.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location name (for example Farm or Greenhouse).

itemId.title: Item ID
itemId.description: Game item identifier used by the action.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of items to place or consume.

soilHealth.title: Soil health
soilHealth.description: Measured soil health value to seed, in the 0-100 range, or "NaN" for unmeasured.

macroFile.title: Macro file
macroFile.description: Relative .txt macro file for a runMacro step.

step.title: Step
step.description: A single ordered step in the scenario. Array order is the single source of truth.

action.title: Action
action.description: Primitive action vocabulary owned and versioned by the runner (C-SCN-32). Composite keywords are deferred until at least three features reuse a sequence.

target.title: Target
target.description: Target tile, location, or object identifier for the action.

days.title: Days
days.description: Number of in-game days the action spans. Only meaningful for sleep and multi-day actions.

inputs.title: Step inputs
inputs.description: Action-specific inputs. Optional; omitted means an empty object.

predicate.title: Predicate
predicate.description: Machine-evaluable threshold predicate (C-SCN-29). The discriminated 'op' field selects exactly one variant. Two independent readers MUST compute the same pass/fail result from the predicate plus the captured signal.

oneOf.title: Comparison predicate
oneOf.description: Compares a signal field (left) to a typed operand (right). The operand type MUST match the field type: numbers for numeric fields, booleans for boolean fields, strings for string fields. The "NaN" sentinel is not a valid comparison operand; use the sentinel predicate instead.

left.title: Left operand
left.description: Signal field evaluated on the left side of the comparison.

operator.title: Comparison operator
operator.description: Comparison operator. Ordering operators (lt/lte/gt/gte) are valid only for numeric fields; eq/ne apply to all types.

right.title: Comparison operand
right.description: Typed operand; the applicable branch is selected by the field type.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for floating-point comparison. Ignored for boolean and string fields.

oneOf.title: Between predicate
oneOf.description: Asserts that a numeric signal field lies inside an interval. Both bounds are inclusive by default; set exclusiveMin/exclusiveMax to make a bound open. tolerance is applied to both bounds. min MUST be less than or equal to max; the runner rejects min > max as a scenario-contract error (exit 14).

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Lower bound. Must be less than or equal to max.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Upper bound. Must be greater than or equal to min.

exclusiveMin.title: Minimum exclusive
exclusiveMin.description: When true, the lower bound is open (actual > min). Default false makes the lower bound inclusive.

exclusiveMax.title: Maximum exclusive
exclusiveMax.description: When true, the upper bound is open (actual < max). Default false makes the upper bound inclusive; set true to encode [34, 67).

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance applied to both bounds.

oneOf.title: Multiplier predicate
oneOf.description: Asserts that a numeric field equals round(base x factor) within tolerance, clamped to the field minimum when clampToFieldMinimum is true. base is the pre-run capture of the same field; the runner rejects a base whose suffix does not equal field (exit 14). For phaseDays the clamp minimum is 1; the 99999 sentinel is never multiplied.

base.title: Multiplier base
base.description: Pre-run field reference, for example pre.phaseDays. The suffix MUST equal field; the runner validates this cross-field rule and exits 14 on mismatch.

factor.title: Multiplier factor
factor.description: Multiplicative factor (for example 1.15 for poor soil). Bounded to [0.01, 100] to reject zero/negative/absurd factors.

rounding.title: Rounding rule
rounding.description: Rounding applied to base x factor before comparison. round uses midpoint-to-even (bankers rounding) as implemented by Math.Round; none compares the unrounded product.

clampToFieldMinimum.title: Clamp to field minimum
clampToFieldMinimum.description: When true, the computed value is clamped to the field minimum declared by the signal (phaseDays minimum 1). The 99999 sentinel is never multiplied or clamped.

oneOf.title: Sentinel predicate
oneOf.description: Asserts that a named sentinel condition holds for a signal field. The sentinel MUST belong to the field semantic class (mapping enforced below): SENTINEL_UNTOUCHED_99999 -> phaseDays; NAN_HEALTH/MISSING_KEY/HEALTH_LE_ZERO/POOR_POSITIVE_LT_34 -> healthTier; PHASE_MINUS_ONE -> currentPhase.

mustNotChange.title: Must not change
mustNotChange.description: Whether the sentinel value must remain unchanged relative to its pre-run baseline.

oneOf.title: Composite predicate
oneOf.description: Combines child predicates with logical allOf or anyOf.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: A machine-evaluable acceptance criterion (oracle) for one signal.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Which captured signal this threshold evaluates.

modConstant.title: ModConstants reference
modConstant.description: Optional name of the ModConstants member whose value the predicate encodes (FR-007). The numeric value in the predicate remains authoritative; the runner may cross-check the name against the compiled constant and fail on mismatch.

description.title: Human-readable description
description.description: Optional companion prose; never the sole source of pass/fail.

condition.title: Deprecated condition
condition.description: Deprecated alias for description; retained for one major version in schemaVersion 2. Do not use in new scenarios.

hostGuard.title: Host-guard expectations
hostGuard.description: Observable contract for a farmhand (non-host) scenario. A breach is execution evidence without the skip line.

skipLine.const: Soil growth modifier skipped: not main player.
skipLine.title: Expected skip line
skipLine.description: The exact SMAPI log line that must be present for a farmhand scenario.
examples: Soil growth modifier skipped: not main player.

forbiddenEvidence.title: Forbidden execution evidence
forbiddenEvidence.description: Evidence that must be absent when the skip line is present. Presence of any item indicates a host-guard breach (verdict fail, exit 18, non-retryable).

requireSkipLine.title: Require skip line
requireSkipLine.description: Whether the skip line is mandatory. Always true in v2; retained for forward compatibility.

healthTier.title: Health tier
healthTier.description: Derived soil-health class from C-DMP-01. unknown = missing/NaN (non-participant); poor = strictly positive health < 34; moderate = [34, 67); healthy = >= 67. Zero is a measured floor and maps to poor, never unknown.
